cases.question: Should I check the engine oil level with the engine running or stopped?
required_facts: Engine oil level is checked with engine off.

passages.shown_text: NOTE · Engine oil level is checked with engine off. · If oil level checks above 'FULL," it may be due to oil cooler drain back. Operate the engine for one minute, shut down, wait one minute, and recheck oil level. · Vehicles equipped with deep fording kit will have a sealed dipstick.

cases.question: One ceiling light in the ambulance has failed. If inspection shows it needs a bulb, what must be turned off before changing it?
required_facts: When changing light bulbs, ensure the system in which the bulb is being replaced is turned off.

passages.shown_text: 28. CEIUNG WHITE UGHT OR BLACKOUT UGHT FAILS TO ILLUMINATE Step 1. Inspect bulb for serviceability. Replace bulb with known serviceable bulb (para. 3-28). Step 2. Other causes. Notify unit maintenance.
